sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Cats Picnic Link is a Match 3 Puzzle Game, where players connect three or more similar Fish items to clear the board. The game features a 5x5 grid, where Fish of various colors and types are scattered throughout. The objective is to clear the board by creating matches of three or more Fish in a horizontal or vertical line.

The gameplay is straightforward, with players using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move Fish around the grid. As players create matches, the Fish are removed from the board, and new ones take their place. The game becomes increasingly challenging as players progress, with new obstacles and power-ups introduced to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.

One of the key mechanics in Cats Picnic Link is the use of power-ups. These special items can be earned or purchased with in-game currency, providing players with a boost in their gameplay experience. Power-ups can take many forms, such as extra moves, Fish bombs, or even a temporary shield to protect against obstacles. By using power-ups strategically, players can clear the board more efficiently and earn higher scores.

As players progress through the game, new Fish types are introduced, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics. For example, some Fish may have a higher score value, while others may have special abilities, such as moving extra spaces or clearing a larger area. By mastering the different Fish types and using them effectively, players can improve their gameplay and earn higher scores.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks

2. Use the Fish bombs to clear large areas of the board and earn bonus points.
3. Focus on creating matches of four or more Fish to earn higher scores.
